Distinction & equivalence

Specify what counts as the same and what distinctions survive.

Grouping / partition

Collect objects by an explicit equivalence or assignment rule.

Symmetry & chirality

Study transformation-preserved structure and when mirror-related objects remain inequivalent.

Discrete & continuous

Make the topology or representation explicit before claiming a system is discrete or continuous.

Recurrence, sensitivity, periodicity, chaos

Repeated rules may contract, preserve, amplify, cycle, or reorganize differences. Recurrence alone does not imply chaos.

Coarse-graining, hierarchy, signal/noise

Compress fine descriptions into task-dependent macro-descriptions and track what information was intentionally discarded.

Optimization, local/global, exploration

Separate the objective from the search dynamics and distinguish local improvement from global optimality.

Collatz frontier

A simple integer recurrence is used as an unresolved case study. QEVA does not label it chaotic without a precise proven criterion.
